title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1989-07-17
lineage: DAT > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Flac 16/48
source: flac16/48kHz; Ted Mattes Master DAT Recording: Schoeps CMC4 MK4 > DAT; Recorded off the delay stacks from the lawn; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: A faithful lawn‑audience capture that delivers a great show, though a few listeners describe the sound as slightly dull.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a “great show,” and praise Ted Mattes’ Schoeps taper for reproducing exactly what was heard on the lawn. One reviewer notes the recording can sound a bit dull compared with other Schoeps sources, but overall the tape is considered lively and true to the night’s atmosphere.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for the performance (70% weight) and generally good audience recording quality (30% weight); minor comment about dullness lowers the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Schoeps lawn mic captures the ambience accurately; some listeners feel it sounds a bit dull compared with other Schoeps tapes, but overall it's clear and faithful to the live experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers mention the concert was great overall, though no specific songs or set‑list details are highlighted.
